secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_ID
secrets.description: Base44 app ID from the Builder dashboard (FleetLink Dispatch Pro). Identifies the app for the frontend SDK.

secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Hosted Base44 app base URL (e.g. https://your-app.base44.app). The Vite plugin proxies /api here.

secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_FUNCTIONS_VERSION
secrets.description: Optional: Base44 functions version tag for controlling which backend function versions run.

secrets.name: SMTP_HOST
secrets.description: SMTP server host for sending emails (used by Base44 backend email functions).
